scope: English Repos base game (2021 publication), sc-en01, © 2020; complete STANDARD game; optional Add a Challenge excluded

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook pp. 1 and 6, opening description and END OF THE GAME
checked_claims.assessment: Cooperative word association; total team score and high-score objective are accurate.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 1, CONTENTS
checked_claims.assessment: 220 Keyword cards, 6 boards, 6 erasable markers, 1 Record of Legends, and rulebook match.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 1, SETUP steps 1–3
checked_claims.assessment: Each player receives a board and marker; deck shuffled face down within reach; four cards placed randomly in recessed spots and concealed.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 2, GAMEPLAY and CHOOSING CLUES; p. 4, transition paragraph
checked_claims.assessment: Individual simultaneous secret clue writing precedes the team resolution phase.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 2, CHOOSING CLUES text and labeled board diagram; inspected pdf-page-2.png
checked_claims.assessment: Eight outside-edge Keywords make four Pairs, each consisting of the two words below the corresponding Clue Zone. Clues connect both words.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 2, final paragraph
checked_claims.assessment: Single word with compound words allowed; noun, proper noun, acronym, number, and onomatopoeia categories and examples match.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 3, Invalid Clues
checked_claims.assessment: Keyword itself, translation, same-family word, and made-up word restrictions, including their examples, are correctly conveyed.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Special Rules & Edge Cases, final bullet
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 2, requirement for each of four Pairs; p. 3, ADVICE
checked_claims.assessment: Advice to use the first word that comes to mind does not waive legal Clue constraints or the requirement for all four Clues.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Choosing Clues, numbered preparation steps 1–3; Player Reference step 3
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 4, opening paragraph; inspected pdf-page-4.png
checked_claims.assessment: Remove four originals, add exactly one card without looking, shuffle all five, then place board in front of owner with all five cards in a face-down pile on it.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Choosing Clues, final sentence; Turn Structure
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 4, second paragraph and RESOLUTION opening
checked_claims.assessment: Wait until everyone finishes preparation; choose the first Spectator at the start of Resolution.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Turn Structure; Resolution and verification, opening paragraph
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 4, RESOLUTION first two paragraphs
checked_claims.assessment: Board owner serves as Spectator once; every other player participates in reconstructing that board; spectator cannot communicate in any way.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 4, RESOLUTION second paragraph; p. 2 board diagram; p. 5 verification diagram
checked_claims.assessment: Board and all five cards are face up in the middle. Four originals occupy correct spaces and orientations, with the added card left off the board.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Resolution and verification, first-attempt error bullet
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 5, VERIFICATION diagram; inspected pdf-page-5.png; p. 2 diagram
checked_claims.assessment: The bottom-left original card is marked incorrect with a rotation arrow while three other cards are marked correct. Orientation being material is supported by the diagram, not invented from text alone.

checked_claims.claim: Discussion, final decision, and attempt commitment
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 4, disagreement paragraph, ADVICE, and closing paragraph
checked_claims.assessment: Players may test arrangements and discuss; player to Spectator’s left decides disagreements; verification occurs when placement is agreed.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Resolution and verification, first outcome bullet; scoring table
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 5, VERIFICATION / First attempt / Perfect
checked_claims.assessment: All Pairs correct earns four one-point cards and a two-point bonus, totaling six; second attempt is only for an error.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Resolution and verification, error bullet; Special Rules & Edge Cases, feedback bullet
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 5, First attempt / Error; p. 4, communication restriction
checked_claims.assessment: Spectator silently removes incorrect cards into the middle; others receive a second and final attempt. Summary does not incorrectly discard these cards or add verbal feedback.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Resolution and verification, second-attempt bullet; Scoring / Victory Conditions; Special Rules & Edge Cases
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 5, Second attempt
checked_claims.assessment: After new agreed placement, incorrect cards go into the middle; score one per correct card, zero to four, with no first-try bonus and no third attempt.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Resolution and verification, closing paragraph; Player Reference step 6
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 5, lower closing box
checked_claims.assessment: Turn board over, write points in middle, discard all five cards, then player to the left becomes next Spectator.

checked_claims.summary_reference: Scoring / Victory Conditions, final paragraph; Player Reference step 7
checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook p. 6, END OF THE GAME
checked_claims.assessment: End after everyone has been Spectator once, total all board points, and record team total in Record of Legends.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook pp. 1–6, complete standard rules; p. 6 ADD A CHALLENGE considered only for scope exclusion
checked_claims.assessment: No material standard-game rule omission found. Optional Add a Challenge is deliberately excluded as requested.

checked_claims.source_reference: Rulebook pp. 1–6; designer on pp. 1 and 6, copyright on p. 6
checked_claims.assessment: Designer and © 2020 attribution match. Player count and duration are not stated in supplied rulebook, consistent with header. The audit uses the explicitly assigned 2021 publication/sc-en01 scope; publication year is not independently established by the PDF text.

source_read_method: Read complete supplied extraction and all six pages of the authoritative PDF via pypdf text extraction. Inspected the permitted PDF page 2, 4, and 5 renders, including pair geometry and the rotated-card verification diagram. Hashes cover exact source file bytes.
independence_statement: I independently compared only the exact summary snapshot, complete extracted rulebook, complete authoritative PDF, and the three specifically permitted page renders. I did not author repairs or consult questions, answer keys, reader outputs, grades, earlier summaries or audits, coverage reports, parent history, other project files, or external sources. The verification banner was not evidence for this verdict. No summary edits were made.
